description.fallback: Boruto doesn't recognise his surroundings when he wakes up. He exchanges words with Kiri bounty hunter Anaguma, and asks about an exit. Anaguma points him to a Fire Release user, who has been trying to break out for a while with no result, and accidentally hits Shamo, an Iwa shinobi as he approaches.

outro.fallback: A Kumo kunoichi has no recollection of it, but the old man blames it on the gas, claiming that many passengers died over inhaling too much of the gas.

Before letting them go, the man wants them to go through a test, believing that the choices they just happened to make that allowed to survive were not coincidences, but a subconscious ability to avoid death.
